correctness.rationale: Every forbidden t-clique is either wholly in one clique blade or contains the central vertex and t−1 vertices in a blade. Hub deletion is the join of K(a_i,t−1) and link the join of K(a_i,t−2), each a truncated simplex. If any a_i<t−1, that vertex is universally addable and X is a cone. Otherwise top homology of each skeleton is Λ^r ker(sum:Z^{a_i}→Z); join dimensions and Künneth give deletion dimension p=k(t−1)−1 and link q−1=k(t−2)−1. The inclusion L→D is null because D is (p−1)-connected and p≥q+1; the mapping cone splits as D∨ΣL. Natural long exact sequence in separated degrees identifies the full integral Γ-modules as tensor exterior powers, with Koszul (-1)^r on blade-factor swaps. The determinant generating function ∏(1−(−z)^cycle_length)/(1+z) yields the stated cycle-index character. Direct small t=3, blades (3,3) binary homology gives four S² and one S³ as asserted; all-parameter proof is combinatorial, not from finite tests.
residual_risks: Only this graph family; ordinary homotopy splitting, Γ-action asserted on integral homology only.
